title: PREVENTION AND CARE OF SPORTS INJURIES
modules: First Aid For Some Sports Injuries
Mechanisms And Types Of Sports Injuries
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those injuries one incurs when taking part in exercise or sports."
Recall that sports injuries are those injuries one incurs when taking part in exercise or sports.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bundle of contractile cells or fibres that bring about movement when it contracts or produces force."
Muscles A muscle is a bundle of contractile cells or fibres that bring about movement when it contracts or produces force.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very strong structure that attaches a muscle to a bone and concentrates a pulling force in a limited area."
A tendon is a very strong structure that attaches a muscle to a bone and concentrates a pulling force in a limited area.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sterile material, usually guaze, used to cover a wound, to control bleeding and prevent contamination (Pfeiffer and Mangus, 2012)."
Dressing is a sterile material, usually guaze, used to cover a wound, to control bleeding and prevent contamination (Pfeiffer and Mangus, 2012).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most common vital signs to be assessed by you."
Heart rate is one of the most common vital signs to be assessed by you.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most popular and strongest among the tendons."
Achilles tendon (heel) is one of the most popular and strongest among the tendons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the stretch or tear of the tendon or junction between tendon and muscle (TMJ)."
Strains are the stretch or tear of the tendon or junction between tendon and muscle (TMJ).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that develop slowly over a period of time, may be weeks or more."
Chronic injuries are those that develop slowly over a period of time, may be weeks or more.
fib: ______ is a possibility with any injury, but it is most common in severe hemorrhage (bleeding), fractures, or internal injuries.
Shock
Shock is a possibility with any injury, but it is most common in severe hemorrhage (bleeding), fractures, or internal injuries.
______ are used in soccer and hockey to cover the lower extremity.
shin guards
The shin guards are used in soccer and hockey to cover the lower extremity.
______ is the next component of the principle.
Rest
Rest is the next component of the principle.
______ is a method of inflating an injured person's lungs with air from your lungs.
Mouth-to-mouth resuscitation
Mouth-to-mouth resuscitation is a method of inflating an injured person's lungs with air from your lungs.
______ are the most popular bone injuries in sports.
Fractures
Fractures are the most popular bone injuries in sports.
______ are used for ankle wraps and for triangular bandages and cravat or neckband.
Cotton cloths
Cotton cloths are used for ankle wraps and for triangular bandages and cravat or neckband.

cartilage
